description: Pay for 2 to 10 calls with ONE Lightning invoice, up to 2,000 sats in all. Each item is { toolName, ...the same inputs create_payment takes for that tool }. The server checks and prices EVERY item first: one bad item refuses the whole cart, with no invoice, and the error names the item by its index. Returns JSON: { cartId, lightningInvoice, totalSats, expiresAt, items: [{ index, toolName, paymentId, amountSats }] }. Pay the ONE invoice. Then call each item's tool with that item's own paymentId, exactly as you would after create_payment. KEEP the paymentIds from this reply: each is the only way to use that item or to be refunded for it, and nothing can show them to you again. check_payment_status(cartId) shows the state of each item (it never repeats the paymentIds). An item you do not use is refunded for its own price after about an hour. Only one-shot tools can be in a cart (text, translation, image tools, document tools, text_to_speech); for calls, SMS, fax, email, video, music and other long jobs use create_payment.

items.description: The calls to pay for. Each item is an object with toolName and the inputs create_payment takes for that tool (for example prompt for generate_text, text and targetLanguage for translate_text).

fileContext.description: For generate_text: attached file text, if any (it is part of the price).

modelId.description: Optional. AI model id or name, as for create_payment.

prompt.description: For generate_text and translate_text: the exact text you will send (the price is its character count, locked to the item).

quantity.description: For extract_document and extract_receipt: the pages. Default 1.

resolution.description: For image tools priced by size: the resolution, as for create_payment.

systemPrompt.description: For generate_text: the system prompt, if you use one (it is part of the price).

targetLanguage.description: For translate_text: the target language (it picks the engine and so the price).

text.description: For text_to_speech and translate_text: the exact text (priced per character, locked to the item).

toolName.description: The tool this item pays for.

name: create_cart
